title: Template:MapWinner/doc
wikitext:
This template is used by {{Tl|BracketMatchSummary}} to render each map as a row within the match detail popup. It needs wrapping code to actually work, that's why you'll never call this template directly. It shows mapname, score1, score2 and overtimes if set. === Example ===
{{BracketMatchSummary |map1=aerowalk |map1win=1 |map1p1frags=38 |map1p2frags=14 |map1ot=2 }}

''(The above rendering may look bad. It's a simulation. When in real use - by {{Tl|BracketMatchSummary}} - it gets the correct styling.)''
